reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/direct calls; independent pyelftools symbol/PT_LOAD mapping and Capstone original-ELF disassembly; resolved PC-relative string literal
reviewed_findings.claim: Encoder format 0xb selects the concrete HEVC class; HEVC Configure opens /dev/d5_hevc and submits ioctl 0xc10c7408. Recorder constructs parameterized source/encoder/mux buffer routes.
limitations: Class/enum and object-field meanings partly inferred; indirect calls not fully resolved.
This does not establish supported modes, bitrate limits, frame timing, thermal performance or active INI consumption.
unresolved_questions: Resolve sysconfig provider and real codec-mode fields.
Trace M4 image loading and kernel HEVC ioctl handler.

reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/direct calls; independent pyelftools symbol/PT_LOAD mapping and Capstone original-ELF disassembly; resolved PC-relative literals
reviewed_findings.claim: Poweroff public wrapper requests pwroff-popup via AF_UNIX stream /tmp/sn and helper reads a four-byte response.
limitations: Wire framing and library code only; daemon action, acknowledgement meaning and final hardware shutdown are unreviewed.
Ghidra infers a void helper signature despite instruction return-value flow; no source ABI claim.
unresolved_questions: Determine completion semantics and in-flight capture/transfer policy.

reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/direct calls; independent pyelftools symbol/PT_LOAD mapping and Capstone original-ELF disassembly; resolved PC-relative device-path literals
reviewed_findings.claim: MICOM status and body battery SOC wrappers open /dev/micom-ctrl; status ioctl0x80044d00 maps second response word0xa5 to output0, and body SOC ioctl0x80044d05 copies its word to caller.
limitations: Only user-space wrappers inspected; no kernel/microcontroller command ABI, units, calibration, SOC policy or device readings established.
unresolved_questions: Resolve MICOM driver handlers and response structure.
Trace battery low threshold and shutdown policy in deviced.
